metadata.title: Jiangsu Huacheng Technology | Smart Railway Infrastructure Monitoring
metadata.description: Jiangsu Huacheng Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in smart railway infrastructure monitoring, providing intelligent sensing-based railway condition monitoring and predictive maintenance systems under the Belt and Road Initiative.

hero.badge: China-Kazakhstan Demo Project · Belt and Road Initiative

about.title: A Leading Global Provider of Smart Railway Solutions
about.description: Jiangsu Huacheng Technology Co., Ltd. is dedicated to smart railway infrastructure monitoring. Through technological innovation and industrial cooperation, we deeply integrate intelligent sensing, edge computing, cloud computing and artificial intelligence to provide end-to-end digital transformation solutions for the global railway industry.

architecture.title: Device-Edge-Cloud Collaborative Architecture
architecture.subtitle: Three-layer collaborative design integrating sensing, computing and intelligence

layers.name: Device Sensing Layer
layers.description: Intelligent sensing devices deployed on railway sleepers at ~30m intervals, enabling high-density, real-time and continuous track condition perception.

layers.name: Edge Computing Layer
layers.subname: ECG Edge Gateway + RES Regional Server
layers.description: Deployed along the railway, aggregating and processing data within 1-2 km range, transforming raw signals into high-value feature insights.

layers.name: Cloud Computing Platform
layers.description: Acts as the brain: massive data aggregation, storage, deep analysis, model training and global situational awareness with elastic scaling.
specs: S3 Data Lake, Massive Data Repository

case.title: Kazakhstan Smart Railway Pilot Project
case.subtitle: China-Kazakhstan demonstration project serving the Belt and Road and China-Europe Railway Express
features: Straight section: baseline track condition monitoring
Station throat turnout cluster: critical component monitoring
